checkRuns.command:
sed -i "/else Astro.response.status = 400;/d" src/pages/contact.astro
bun run build 2>&1 | tail -15

pkill -f "dist/server/entry.mjs"; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -4 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -1
(PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 2
B=http://127.0.0.1:4701
echo "--- invalid"; curl -s -w '%{http_code}\n' -X POST -d 'name=+&email=bad@x&message=short' $B/contact | sed 's/></>\n</g' | grep -i 'error\|value=\|textarea\|success'
echo "--- invalid w/ origin"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -H "Origin: http://localhost:4701" -H "Host: localhost:4701" -X POST -d 'name=&email=&message=' $B/contact
echo "--- valid"; curl -s -w '%{http_code}\n' -H "Origin: http://127.0.0.1:4701" -X POST --data-urlencode 'name=  Ada  ' --data-urlencode 'email=ada@example.com' --data-urlencode 'message=Hello there, this is a long message.' $B/contact | grep -o 'Thanks[^<]*\|value="[^"]*"'
echo "--- json"; curl -s -H 'Accept: application/json' -X POST -F 'name=Ada' -F 'email=x' -F 'message=hi' $B/contact; echo
curl -s $B/contact | grep -o '<form[^>]*>\|<label[^>]*>[^<]*'

bun run check 2>&1 | tail -4 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -1
(PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 2
B=http://127.0.0.1:4701
echo "--- invalid"; curl -s -w '%{http_code}\n' -X POST -d 'name=+&email=bad@x&message=short' $B/contact | sed 's/></>\n</g' | grep -i 'error\|value=\|textarea\|success'
echo "--- invalid w/ origin"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -H "Origin: http://localhost:4701" -H "Host: localhost:4701" -X POST -d 'name=&email=&message=' $B/contact
echo "--- valid"; curl -s -w '%{http_code}\n' -H "Origin: http://127.0.0.1:4701" -X POST --data-urlencode 'name=  Ada  ' --data-urlencode 'email=ada@example.com' --data-urlencode 'message=Hello there, this is a long message.' $B/contact | grep -o 'Thanks[^<]*\|value="[^"]*"'
echo "--- json"; curl -s -H 'Accept: application/json' -X POST -F 'name=Ada' -F 'email=x' -F 'message=hi' $B/contact; echo
curl -s $B/contact | grep -o '<form[^>]*>\|<label[^>]*>[^<]*'

bun run check 2>&1 | tail -3 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -1
PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production nohup bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > /tmp/srv.pid; sleep 2
B=http://127.0.0.1:4701
for o in http://127.0.0.1:4701 http://localhost:4701 http://evil.com; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "$o %{http_code}\n" -H "Origin: $o" -X POST -d 'name=a' $B/contact; done
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "localhost host %{http_code}\n" -H "Origin: http://localhost:4701" http://localhost:4701/contact -X POST -d name=a
curl -s -H "Origin: http://127.0.0.1:4701" -X POST --data-urlencode 'name=  Ada  ' --data-urlencode 'email= ada@example.com ' --data-urlencode 'message=Hello there, this is a long message.' $B/contact | grep -o 'Thanks[^<]*\|value="[^"]*"\|<textarea[^>]*>[^<]*'
curl -s -H 'Accept: application/json' -X POST -F 'name= Bob ' -F 'email=b@b.co' -F 'message=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa' $B/contact; echo
curl -s -X POST -d 'name=&email=&message=' $B/contact | grep -o 'error"[^>]*>[^<]*'
for p in / /books /nothing /books/nope; do echo "$p $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' $B$p)"; done

kill $(cat /tmp/srv.pid) 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.5; ss -ltnp | grep 4701
bun run build 2>&1 | tail -1
PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production nohup bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > /tmp/srv.pid; sleep 2
bun add -d happy-dom 2>&1 | tail -1

B=http://127.0.0.1:4701 for p in / /books /books/moby-dick /about /contact /nope; do echo "$p: $(curl -s $B$p | grep -o ' content/books/aaa-test.md bun run build 2>&1 | tail -1 PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 NODE_ENV=production nohup bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/srv.pid; sleep 2 curl -s $B/ | grep -o '
    .*
'; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} ' $B/books/aaa-test; curl -s $B/books | grep -o 'data-tag="zzz"' kill $(cat /tmp/srv.pid); rm content/books/aaa-test.md

rm -rf .tmp-test && bun remove happy-dom 2>&1 | tail -1
bun run check 2>&1 | tail -3 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -1
PORT=4702 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4702 NODE_ENV=production nohup bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > /tmp/srv.pid; sleep 2
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:4702/books
kill $(cat /tmp/srv.pid); sleep 0.5; ss -ltnp | grep -c ':470' ; git status --short; cat package.json | grep -A8 '"dependencies"'
